app.name: Renaissance
app.tagline: Your music. Any words. Any language.

ask.hint: A song, a mood, a chore, a request. Try "play something calm for cooking"
ask.noResults: Nothing matches yet. Try the song or artist's name
ask.signInFirst: Sign in to search your library
ask.hubOff: Smart search can't be reached right now. Try again in a minute
ask.modelOff: Smart answers are off right now. Type a song or artist name
ask.budgetOff: This month's smart-answer allowance is used up until the 1st. Names still work
ask.rejected_other: {{count}} suggestions were left out because they aren't in your library or the catalogue
ask.rejected_one: One suggestion was left out because it isn't in your library or the catalogue
ask.alreadyHere: Already on the server. Added to your music
ask.addFailed: Could not add that. Try again
ask.playerUnavailable: Playback isn't connected on this device yet

home.empty: Sign in to a server to see your music here
home.emptyBody: Renaissance plays from your own Jellyfin server. Sign in once and your songs, recent plays and mixes appear here.
home.recentEmpty: What you play shows up here
home.mixesEmpty: Mixes built from what you play appear here, each named in words

signIn.title: Sign in to your server
signIn.notYet: Sign-in arrives in phase 1. This screen is a placeholder.

library.empty: Your library appears here after you sign in
library.mineSignIn: Sign in to see your music
library.mineEmptyBody: Ask for a song or add one from the catalogue and it lands here.

requests.emptyBody: Ask for a song or an album and it shows up here with its progress.
requests.signIn: Sign in to see your requests
requests.signInBody: Requests belong to the person who asked. Sign in and yours appear here with their progress.
requests.hubOff: Requests can't be reached right now
requests.tooLate: {{title}} has started downloading and cannot be cancelled

reason.catalogue_miss: This song isn't in the music catalogue. Check the spelling or try the artist's name
reason.no_results: We couldn't find this one anywhere right now. Try again later
reason.no_candidates: Files turned up, but none was this song. Try again later
reason.download_failed: The download didn't finish. Try again
reason.lidarr_artist: The artist couldn't be set up on the server. Whoever runs the server can look
reason.lidarr_album: The album couldn't be set up on the server. Whoever runs the server can look
reason.track_unmapped: The file didn't match a song on the album. Whoever runs the server can look
reason.import_failed: It arrived but couldn't be filed. Whoever runs the server can look
reason.not_configured: Fetching isn't set up on the server yet
reason.interrupted: The server restarted while this was in progress. Try again
reason.not_found_in_time: Nobody had this album in a week. Try again later

notFound.title: There is no page at this address
notFound.body: The address may be mistyped, or the page moved. Home has everything.

error.title: Something went wrong on this page
error.body: Nothing was changed. Go home and try again.

summary.alreadyHere: {{title}} by {{artist}} is already on the server. Added to your music
summary.lookupCatalogue_one: Looked up "{{query}}" in the catalogue: {{count}} result
summary.lookupCatalogue_other: Looked up "{{query}}" in the catalogue: {{count}} results

why.budget: This month's smart-answer allowance is used up until the 1st. Names still work
why.error: Smart answers didn't come through. Type a song or artist name
why.refusal: I can't help with that one. Try a song, an artist or a mood
why.nothing: Nothing in your library or the catalogue matches that. Check the spelling or try the artist's name
